The companion has been tried on the author's own nights and on logs other
observatories published; a night from yours, with your own view of what
really happened, is the evidence it has least of. It touches nothing on
your rig.

**What it said**

Paste what `python companion.py report ...` wrote (the command you ran
too). Take out any folder path or file name that says who or where you
are.

```
paste here
```

**What really happened**, as far as you know: cloud, a guiding problem,
focus, a gap you remember. Where the companion was wrong, or said "not
known" when you know, say so: that is the most useful part.
